svg.title: Which checkout hooks fire in the shortcode checkout and in the Checkout block
svg.desc: Two columns compare one order placed through the shortcode checkout and one placed through the Store API that the Checkout block calls. Hooks that fired only in the shortcode checkout: woocommerce_before_checkout_form, woocommerce_checkout_fields, woocommerce_billing_fields, woocommerce_review_order_before_payment, woocommerce_checkout_process, woocommerce_after_checkout_validation, woocommerce_checkout_create_order, woocommerce_checkout_update_order_meta, woocommerce_checkout_order_created, woocommerce_checkout_order_processed. Hooks that fired only in the Store API checkout: woocommerce_store_api_checkout_update_order_from_request, woocommerce_checkout_validate_order_before_payment, woocommerce_store_api_checkout_update_order_meta, woocommerce_store_api_checkout_order_processed. Hooks that fired in both: woocommerce_before_calculate_totals, woocommerce_cart_calculate_fees, woocommerce_add_to_cart, woocommerce_new_order, woocommerce_update_order, woocommerce_order_status_changed and the status hook woocommerce_order_status_on-hold.
svg.text: Two checkouts, two sets of hooks
Traced on WooCommerce 11.2.1, one bank-transfer order each; the lists are hooks that fired at least once

g.text: Replace them in the block checkout with
the Store API hooks on the right, the Additional
Checkout Fields API and ExtendSchema callbacks
Not fired on the Checkout block page or in the request
Fired once, but documented as having no effect
Fired in both: safe places for rules and side effects that must hold in either checkout
woocommerce_check_cart_items (cart validation, used by the parcel weight rule)
woocommerce_new_order, woocommerce_update_order (CRUD events of the order object)
Count to remember: woocommerce_order_status_changed fired twice in the Store API
checkout and once in the shortcode checkout, because the Store API order starts as a draft.
A listener that logs "order placed" must filter on the old and new status.

svg.text: Method: a request header lists the hooks to watch and an all-hook callback counts them (the tracer shown on the page).
